name: Kimochi e ~Zecchou Kansenshou~
source:
Main character is a pimp in charge of three women. One day he gets infected with a disease that can only be countered by having sex with women with antibodies. But he can't afford that with the money he has, so he needs to make a lot of money with the three women he controls now.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名皮條客，控制著三名女性。一天，他感染了一種疾病，只有與體內帶有抗體的女性發生性關係才能緩解。然而，他負擔不起相應費用，因此必須利用手下的三名女性大賺一筆。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
